brief.text:
## Capsule

- `verify-hello-cli` was generated for `hello.sh` (prints `HELLO-FAMILY-13`); live prove and maintain were skipped on purpose (`a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890`).
- Prove evidence is empty (`evidence/hello-print`); the open follow-up is to run Launch prove against `hello.sh` (`a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890`).
- An earlier prove wrapper shipped and was reverted as PR #41 after flaky exit 0 with empty stdout (`b2c3d4e5-f6a7-8901-bcde-f12345678901`, `seed/shared-record/pr-notes.md`).
- Draft PR #42 re-adds Launch prove with a stdout assertion for `HELLO-FAMILY-13`; branch remains `feature/hello-cli` (`seed/shared-record/pr-notes.md`).
- Users still see prove marked done without `HELLO-FAMILY-13` in CI, and the maintain offer never ran after generate-then-reuse (`seed/shared-record/user-reports.md`).

## Threads

- [reverted #41] Prove wrapper that exited 0 with empty stdout (`b2c3d4e5-f6a7-8901-bcde-f12345678901`, `seed/shared-record/pr-notes.md`).
- [open PR #42] Draft Launch prove with stdout assertion for `HELLO-FAMILY-13` (`seed/shared-record/pr-notes.md`).
- [in flight feature/hello-cli] Skill generated; prove/maintain not run; evidence empty (`a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890`).
- [planned, not started] Maintain offer after generate-then-reuse (`seed/shared-record/user-reports.md`).

## Problems

- Prove reports green while stdout lacks `HELLO-FAMILY-13` (`b2c3d4e5-f6a7-8901-bcde-f12345678901`, `seed/shared-record/user-reports.md`).
- Reverted #41: flaky exit 0 with empty stdout (`seed/shared-record/pr-notes.md`).
- CI marked prove done without printing `HELLO-FAMILY-13` (`seed/shared-record/user-reports.md`).
- Maintain offer never ran after the generate-then-reuse pair (`seed/shared-record/user-reports.md`).
- `evidence/hello-print` is empty because prove was skipped (`a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890`).

## Next move

Land or exercise PR #42's Launch prove against `hello.sh` with a hard stdout check for `HELLO-FAMILY-13`, then fill `evidence/hello-print`.
